verdict.rationale: Letta explicitly supports background automation: scheduled tasks to trigger agent prompts on a recurring or future schedule (letta-docs-69), always-on cloud agents that keep running even when the laptop is closed (letta-docs-55, letta-docs-68), Slack integration where agents respond autonomously in channels (letta-docs-73, letta-docs-83), and GitHub integration letting agents autonomously sweep bug reports and open PRs (letta-docs-47, letta-docs-72, letta-docs-84). Background 'dreaming' subagents also autonomously consolidate memory without interrupting active work (letta-docs-27), and a Letta employee corroborates the always-on, persistent-agent design philosophy (letta-comm-8). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that scheduled automations reliably run unattended in production, and more detail on schedule configuration limits.
